explain.title: THE CYCLOID
lines: Fastest path from A to B
Same arrival time from any height

source: Simulated: balls rolling without friction losses, 2.2 m drop
caption: 3 tracks, same start, same finish — which ball wins? 🏁 The curve beats the straight line, and on that curve every ball arrives at the same time, whatever its height. Physics from 1696. What should we test next? 👇 #physics #science #brachistochrone #satisfying #engineering #3d
sources_detail: Brachistochrone: the cycloid is the curve of fastest descent under gravity (Johann Bernoulli, 1696).
Tautochrone: on a cycloid, the time to reach the lowest point does not depend on the starting point (Christiaan Huygens, Horologium Oscillatorium, 1673).
Simulation: rolling solid spheres without slipping (a = 5/7 g), no rolling resistance; track drop 2.2 m, length 3.4 m. Times computed by integrating ds / sqrt(2 g' h).
